name: @pipeworx/mcp-vizier

tools.name: query_catalog
tools.description: VizieR astronomical catalogue service at CDS Strasbourg — return data rows from one published catalogue, identified by its VizieR id such as "I/345/gaia2" (Gaia DR2). Takes optional column selection and a numeric constraint expression, up to 50000 rows. Answers what a published astronomy catalogue records for stars, galaxies or other objects meeting a cut.

tools.name: object
tools.description: Query by object name (resolved via SIMBAD/NED).

catalog.description: Optional catalogue id; default queries all.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-vizier forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the vizier pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
